scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n host,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:host" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @logue/web && npm run build -w @logue/extension && python3.13 -m compileall -q server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/ui --pretty false && tsc -p web --pretty false && tsc -p extension --pretty false
scripts.test: npm run test -w @logue/web && npm run test -w @logue/extension && npm run test:host
scripts.test:host: cd server && python3.13 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -p 'test_*.py'
